title: nazm.resolved/1
description: What checking one module decided about its names (N77, `docs/architecture.md` §7.78): its imports, its definitions and every resolved occurrence of a declared entity, each by durable identity. Written by `nazm resolve` one per line, and stored in the module's check entry (`nazm.check/3`) under the same key. No session id, absolute path, timestamp or load order; locals are absent. Ranges are byte offsets into the source `source` fingerprints.

item.description: The defining item's durable key, `module::kind name`.

member.description: A variant's, field's or payload field's name (`Variant.field` for a payload field); null for the item itself.

module.description: The module's durable key; a package's module carries its package.

source.description: The BLAKE3 fingerprint of the exact source bytes the ranges are into.

written.description: The import's literal as written, without quotes.

module.description: The durable key of the module it names.

interface.description: That module's interface fingerprint when this one was checked against it.

definitions.description: Each declared entity at its name, sorted by range then target.

occurrences.description: Each use of a declared entity, sorted by range then target.
